goal: Prevent local network connectivity loss from incorrectly penalizing and purging remote peers
Avoid marking valid addresses as terrible and halting their relay when other networks are still working
reviewability: Author has been silent for 63 days; a review may wait a long time for a response
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Verified by testing IPv4 and IPv6 reachability scenarios on mainnet (naiyoma)
Support with a suggestion to document unreachable network trade-offs (fjahr)
Concern that unreachable addresses could persist indefinitely was answered (stratospher)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because local connectivity loss on one network causes nodes to penalize and drop valid remote peers
Nodes that lose IPv6 or Tor reachability while IPv4 works will otherwise stop relaying reachable addresses
